field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable the git based configuration backup provider.

field.label: Destination Type
field.help: Keep the configuration history locally, or push it to an upstream repository as well.

field.label: URL
field.help: Target location without credentials, for example ssh://server/project.git or https://server/project.git.

field.label: Force Push
field.help: Force push to origin when the histories diverge. This overwrites the upstream branch.

field.label: User Name
field.help: User name for the upstream repository, use a token in the password field where supported.

field.label: Password
field.help: Password or personal access token for the upstream repository.

field.label: SSH private key
field.help: When provided, ssh based authentication is used with this key.
